subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

I **have seen him yesterday.**
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. saw him yesterday .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the adverb **“yesterday,”** which refers to a specific time in the past. For such situations, the **simple past tense** should be used.
 
• The original sentence uses the present perfect tense **“I have seen him yesterday,”** which is incorrect because the present perfect tense is not used with specific time markers like "yesterday."
 
• The correct verb form is **“saw”** in the simple past tense, as it aligns with the time marker "yesterday."

Correct sentence: *I saw him yesterday*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Present Perfect Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + have/has + past participle.
 
• **Example:** I have seen this movie before.
 
• **Usage: **Used to describe actions that occurred at an unspecified time in the past or actions that continue into the present.
 
 
 
• **Simple Past Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure: **Subject + past simple verb.
 
• **Example: **I saw a bird this morning.
 
• **Usage: **Describes actions that were completed at a specific time in the past.
